transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I’m here because people keep treating this foreclosure like it’s just paperwork or missed payments, but that’s not what’s really going on. I know the bank, the loan servicer, and even some people at my job have been quietly working together to push me out of my house. They can show me whatever papers they want, but I’ve been seeing this for almost two years now.
Have you been hearing voices when no one is there?
No, I don’t think so. I’m not hearing voices like that. It’s more… I’m noticing what people are doing, but I’m not hearing anyone talk when nobody’s there.
Have you had a period when your mood felt unusually high, energized, or irritable for days at a time?
I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve been stressed and upset, but I wouldn’t say I’ve had days where I felt unusually high or energized like that.
Have you used methamphetamine, cocaine, cannabis, or other drugs around the time these experiences started?
I’m not really sure what to say about that. I don’t think there was anything like that tied to when this started. I haven’t noticed it being connected to drugs or anything.
During this time, have you had a period of at least two weeks when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?
I don’t know. I’ve definitely felt worn down and upset at times, but I’m not sure I’d say it was two weeks straight of being depressed most of the day every day.
Have there been times when other people told you your speech was hard to follow or didn’t make sense?
Not that I can think of. People might disagree with what I’m saying sometimes, but I don’t remember anyone telling me my speech itself didn’t make sense or was hard to follow.
Have you found yourself feeling much less interested in being around other people than you used to?

I’m not really sure. I mean, I still deal with people when I need to, especially at work, but I can’t say I’ve been keeping track of whether I’m less interested than before. I haven’t really thought about it that way.
Have you felt that other people could know your thoughts even when you did not say them out loud?

Not exactly like they can hear my thoughts, no. It’s more that people are acting like they know things they shouldn’t know—like the bank, the loan servicer, even people at my job are all quietly working together around this foreclosure. Everyone keeps saying it’s just paperwork and missed payments, but I’ve been seeing the pattern for almost two years, and the papers they show me don’t change that.
Have you seen things that other people could not see?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t seen anything that other people couldn’t see, at least not that I’m aware of.
Have you ever felt that someone else was controlling your thoughts or actions?
No, I wouldn’t say anyone is controlling my thoughts or my actions. I make my own decisions. I may think people are doing things around me, but not like they’re inside my head or making me do things.
Have other people told you that your face shows less emotion than it used to?
No, I don’t think anyone’s said that to me. I haven’t really noticed my face showing less emotion or anything like that.
Before these experiences began, did you have a head injury, seizure, or another major medical illness?
Not that I know of. I don’t remember having a head injury or seizures or some major illness before all this started.
Have these experiences been going on continuously for at least one month?
Yes. It’s been going on a lot longer than a month—about a year and nine months now, since the foreclosure notices and the bank calls started taking over things at home.
Have you felt that you have much less motivation to do everyday things than you used to?

I don’t know… I wouldn’t say I have much less motivation. I still do the things I need to do. Some days I’m tired or distracted, but I haven’t really noticed a big change in wanting to do everyday things.
Do you believe anything impossible is happening to you, such as someone using special powers or technology to control events in your life?

I don’t think it’s like special powers or anything like that. But yes, something is happening that people keep pretending is normal. The bank, the loan servicer, and even some people at my job have been quietly working together to push me out of my house. Everyone says it’s just foreclosure paperwork and missed payments, but I know what I’ve been seeing, and the papers they show me don’t change that.
Because of this situation, have you become unable to do your job the way you used to?

Not completely, no. When it’s just regular work, I still get up, go in, supervise my team, do the schedules, deal with customer problems, that kind of thing. I still take care of myself too.

It gets harder when something at work feels connected to the house situation—like paperwork, mail, or bank calls. That’s when I get distracted and things start feeling like they’re part of it.
Have you used cocaine, methamphetamine, cannabis, or another drug in the past two years?
I’m not really sure what you want me to say there. I don’t have anything specific to report about that.
Do you believe the bank or people at your job are using any hidden technology or other impossible method to influence what happens to you?

No, I’m not saying it’s hidden technology or some impossible method. I don’t think that’s what it is.

I’m saying the bank, the loan servicer, and some people at my job have been quietly working together to push me out of my house. Everyone keeps saying it’s just foreclosure paperwork and missed payments, but that doesn’t explain what I’ve been seeing for almost two years. The papers they show me don’t change that.
Aside from believing these people are working together against you, have you had any other unusual experiences that others said were not real?
No, not really. I mean, aside from the situation with the bank and the people at work, I haven’t had other things like that. Nothing else that people have told me wasn’t real.
In the past two years, have you used cannabis?
I don’t have anything specific to tell you about cannabis.
